result.scope: exact rank three; heavy physical row c>1/2; mixed-support Gram K_H has operator norm kappa<1
result.structural_survivor: If kappa>1/2 then ||sum_(j in H) v_j v_j^T||op>1/2 because sum_(j in H)u_j^2<1/2. Thus an unpaid survivor carries over half of a transverse direction on coordinates with nonzero longitudinal contamination.
result.proof_mechanism: Condition mixed original coordinates; surviving frame is support-separated. Set G=I-K_H, whiten with G^{-1/2}; active matrix M=G^{1/2}Lambda G^{1/2} has s_min>=1-kappa. Conditioned affine term is in active range and is removed by completing the square. Apply partner support-separated theorem at scale 1-kappa and average.

newest_source_applied.actual_inequality: for signature (+,+,-), p_Q(s)<=pi*sqrt(2) on the majority-sign one-sheet half-line s>=0

unresolved_implication.statement: In a heavy-row survivor with transverse mixed Gram operator norm >1/2, prove a full-line/two-sheet interval bound stable as the nonzero longitudinal coefficients on that support tend to zero, retaining original product factorization inside the reciprocal-shear trace and without conditioning those coordinates away or treating them as a small random perturbation.
